chat.empty_hint: Select one of your agents on the left to start chatting.
chat.starter_hint: Say hello — your message will go straight to the agent runtime.
chat.attach_limit: You can attach up to {count} files
chat.drop_hint: Drop files here to attach them
chat.drop_disabled: Wait for the agent to finish replying
chat.attachment_unavailable: This file is no longer available
chat.attachment_not_readable: The agent sees the name, not the contents
chat.error_type: {name} isn't a supported file type. Try an image, a PDF, an Office document, or a text file.
chat.error_total: Those files add up to more than {limit} in one message
chat.error_message: The agent could not take that message: {message}
chat.error_turn_unfinished: The agent did not finish this turn. Send your message again to continue.
chat.not_delivered_hint: The agent did not receive this message — it will be gone unless you resend it
chat.not_delivered_agent_offline: The agent is not running right now, so it did not receive this message. Resend it once the agent is back.
chat.not_delivered_offline: There was no connection to the agent when you sent this. Resend it once the chat has reconnected.
chat.not_delivered_timeout: No confirmation came back, so the agent may not have this message. Resending is safe — it will not be delivered twice.
chat.not_delivered_attachment_failed: An attached file could not be read, so the message did not reach the agent.
chat.new_chat_agent_offline: The agent is unavailable right now
chat.new_chat_answering: Wait for the agent to finish answering
chat.new_chat_confirm_share: Start a new chat? This conversation will be closed and you won't be able to return to it.
chat.new_chat_confirm_console: Start a new chat? This conversation moves to your history, and the agent starts fresh.
chat.new_chat_failed: Could not start a new chat. Your conversation is unchanged.
chat.new_chat_failed_agent_offline: The agent is unavailable, so a new chat could not be started. Your conversation is unchanged.
chat.new_chat_failed_answering: The agent is still answering. Try again when it has finished.

proposal.pending: Waiting for the operator to apply or skip this in the admin console.
proposal.restart_hint: applies on the agent's next restart
proposal.stale: The file changed since this was proposed — the agent needs to propose again.
